mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that potentiate lorazepam's CNS depressant effects and increase seizure risk; both drugs can contribute to neurological toxicity.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely, particularly calcium and magnesium; assess CNS status regularly; consider alternative antivirals if possible; adjust lorazepam dosing based on clinical response and electrolyte correction.
